name: XLA_CONDITIONS_
description: This table contains the conditions for journal line rules, account rules and description rules.

columns.name: CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: USER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Number assigned by the user to indicate the priority of the rule associated with a condition.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to a journal line rule and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to a journal line rule and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of segment rule detail.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_PRIO_ID
columns.description: Identifier of description priority.

columns.name: BRACKET_LEFT_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the left bracket used in a condition.

columns.name: BRACKET_RIGHT_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the right bracket used in a condition.

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Value type code, source or constant.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of source application.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is predefined by subledger application.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting flexfield segment.

columns.name: VALUE_FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Value flexfield segment code.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the source application value.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of the source type value.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of the source value.

columns.name: VALUE_CONSTANT
columns.description: Constant value when the value type is Constant.

columns.name: LINE_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the line operator used in a condition.

columns.name: LOGICAL_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the logical operator used in a condition.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: INDEPENDENT_VALUE_CONSTANT
columns.description: Stores the independent value of a key flexfield.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
